description: Use this when the user asks a research question on the biology of aging, longevity interventions, age-related disease, or the people and companies of the field (does rapamycin extend lifespan in people, who works on epigenetic clocks). Not for personal medical advice, doses or symptoms. Answers in about 350 words from AgingResearch.News's record of papers, trials, approvals, lifespan results, genetics, researchers and companies, with numbered sources, and says when that record is thin. Spends one of the user's Ask questions for the day. Pass conversation_id for a follow-up. If the answer is not ready in the call, read it with get_ask_answer.

conversation_id.description: To ask a follow-up in a conversation this tool or ask_arn started: its `conversation.id`. Leave out to start a new conversation.

question.description: The research question in the user's words, in any language; the answer is written in the question's language.

name: ask_arn
